title: Normalized shifted-unit tensor identification and its chain-map compatibility
statement: Let k be any commutative ring with its chosen module derived category and K-flat derived tensor. Write S(n)=k[-n] for the actual single complex [lem-sc-module-cup-homology-representability]. For all integers p,q there exists an isomorphism e:Q(S(p+q)) to Q(S(p)) tensor-derived Q(S(q)). For every pair of arbitrary complexes K,L and chain maps f:S(p) to K, g:S(q) to L, there exists a chain map h:S(p+q) to K tensor L such that (1) its degree-p+q value at 1 is the (p,q)-tensor-summand inclusion of the degree-p value of f at 1 tensor the degree-q value of g at 1, with no sign; and (2) e.hom followed by Q(f) tensor Q(g) and by the lax tensor comparison at K,L equals Q(h). The value at 1 uses singleObjXSelf.inv in each source. For cocycle maps this explicitly gives compatibility of the shifted-unit identification with tensor representatives.

source.place: Section 15.64, equation-simple-tor-product and the tensor-of-cocycles construction; Tag 0FKU localization tensor comparison

proof.text: Use exists_cupShiftedUnitChainTensor for the normalized ordinary complex isomorphism i. The free rank-one module is flat by ModuleCat.flat_iff_flat, and CochainComplex.kFlat_single_obj_iff_flat proves its single complex is K-flat directly; the bounded-above flat complex node is unnecessary. Apply the source QObjTensorQObjIsoOfKFlatLeft, and identify its hom with the canonical lax comparison by unfolding its quotient/counit composite. Compose Q.mapIso i with the inverse comparison to obtain e.

For each f,g define h=i.hom followed by f tensor g. Evaluate CochainComplex.ιTensorObj_tensorHom_f at the transported 1 tensor 1 and rewrite with the normalization of i to prove the component formula. Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ_natural moves Q(f) tensor Q(g) across the comparison; cancel the flat-model inverse and use Q.map_comp to prove the derived equation. Thus no representative formula remains unproved in this module.

proof_origin.note: One strict underived construction remains. K-flatness, representative tensor formula, and derived compatibility are proved using closed source APIs and lax monoidal naturality.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_cupShiftedUnitTensor (p q : ℤ) :
    ∃ e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (cupSingleModule k (p + q)) ≅
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj (cupSingleModule k p) ⊗
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj (cupSingleModule k q),
    ∀ (K L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} k) ℤ)
      (f : cupSingleModule k p ⟶ K) (g : cupSingleModule k q ⟶ L),
    ∃ h : cupSingleModule k (p + q) ⟶ K ⊗ L,
      ((HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (p + q)
          (ModuleCat.of k k)).inv ≫ h.f (p + q)) (1 : k) =
        (HomologicalComplex.ιTensorObj K L p q (p + q) rfl)
          ((((HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) p
              (ModuleCat.of k k)).inv ≫ f.f p) (1 : k)) ⊗ₜ[k]
            (((HomologicalComplex.singleObjXSelf (ComplexShape.up ℤ) q
              (ModuleCat.of k k)).inv ≫ g.f q) (1 : k))) ∧
      e.hom ≫ (DerivedCategory.Q.map f ⊗ₘ DerivedCategory.Q.map g) ≫
          Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Q K L = DerivedCategory.Q.map h
